title: Tesla’s Door Handles Lead to Its Biggest Recall Yet
summary: The mechanical door handles are especially important when vehicles’ low-voltage batteries fail. (These batteries don’t operate the cars themselves, but power onboard computers, displays, and other accessories, including electronically-powered door handles.) Tesla didn’t respond to WIRED’s request for comment.
